Weather & sound

Raising your flock

Feed and wander Each hen lays an egg after 100 meals, with an adult rooster in the yard. One eaten grain counts as one meal.

A little arrival Eggs hatch on their own in 3 minutes while the chickens roam. Tap an egg to see how soon your chick will arrive.

Room to grow After 200 meals, a chick grows into an adult. There is room for 16 birds and eggs.

A passing foxEvery two active minutes, a fox visits and carries one adult chicken away. The loss is permanent. The last hen and rooster are protected; fox visits pause when you leave the farm or pause its animation.
